content.bio:
/**
 * About me
 * If you ask me what leadership in tech is about, 
 * I will tell you that it is about empowerment, 
 * adaptability, and growth. Leadership means creating
 * an environment where the team can thrive, tackle 
 * challenges, and innovate while striving to make an 
 * impact for the business, the client, and themselves.
 *
 * For the past 7 years in Frontend Development, I’ve 
 * grown from an engineer to a Team Lead, guiding teams 
 * through challenges, driving improvements in workflows, 
 * and helping others unlock their potential. I thrive on 
 * helping, proposing ideas, and optimizing processes to 
 * make teams more self-sufficient and focused on achieving 
 * results.
 *
 * Currently, as a Frontend Team Lead, my primary goal is 
 * to architect processes and frameworks that empower 
 * the team to operate independently and effectively 
 * even with minimal involvement from my side. While 
 * doing so, I also strive to foster a culture of continuous 
 * improvement and growth.
 */
content.interests:
/**
 * Interests
 * I am a proactive and growth-oriented individual 
 * who thrives on solving challenges and fostering 
 * collaboration within teams. I strongly believe that 
 * creating a supportive and empowering environment is 
 * the key to success in both personal and professional life.
 *
 * My focus is on continuous self-improvement, innovation, 
 * and adaptability. I enjoy tackling complex problems, 
 * embracing new technologies, and encouraging my team to 
 * explore creative solutions.
 *
 * I value open communication, trust, and transparency, and 
 * I make it a priority to cultivate an atmosphere where 
 * everyone feels encouraged to contribute ideas and grow.
 *
 * Ultimately, I am driven by curiosity, a passion for impactful 
 * work, and a desire to make a meaningful difference both as 
 * a leader and as an individual.
 */
content.skills:
/**
 * Skills
 * Proficient in modern front-end development 
 * (TypeScript, React, Next.js).
 *
 * Expertise in state management (Zustand, Redux) 
 * and UI libraries (TailwindCSS, etc.).
 *
 * Skilled in building optimized and scalable architectures
 * for enterprise-level projects.
 *
 * Strong foundations in clean code practices, 
 * component-based design, performance optimization.
 *
 * Extensive experience in implementing and maintaining FSD 
 * (Feature-Sliced Design) architecture.
 *
 * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, modern source control
 * tools (Git, GitHub Actions).
 * Knowledge of testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library).
 *
 * Familiar with server-side rendering (SSR), API integration 
 * (REST, GraphQL), and microservices.
 *
 * Effective in project collaboration using 
 * Agile/Scrum methodology.
 */
